scope: The 23 Campbell, Greek Lyric Poetry (1967) poems listed in data/campbell_glp/translation_gaps.json (prior search log kept there). Statuses: found_english | found_other_language | becomes_pd_2027 | none_found. Records for found_* are in translations.jsonl.

edmonds_elegy_and_iambus.note: J. M. Edmonds, Elegy and Iambus (Loeb, London: Heinemann, 1931), 2 vols. HathiTrust catalog API (2026-10-09) lists every copy as rights code 'ic' (Limited, search-only): record 001181589 -> mdp.39015004997139, mdp.39015002201831, mdp.39015026952716 (v.1), mdp.39015004997238, mdp.39015012429190, mdp.39015026952724 (v.2); later printings 001768623 (1954), 008325364 (1961), 006952716 (1993) also 'ic'. No CRMS full-view opening, so it is NOT usable now. It is a UK publication (copyright restored under URAA), so a missing US renewal would not make it PD; it enters the US public domain on 2027-01-01 (published 1931 + 95 years). Copies of this Loeb on Internet Archive under 'in.ernet.dli.2015.*' (Digital Library of India uploads) were seen in search results and must not be used before 2027. Hipponax is not in it (title: 'excepting the choliambic writers'). Edmonds fragment numbers below are the Perseus Hopper labels (CURFRAG tlg-NNNN.N) on the Greek display of the same edition (Perseus:text:2008.01.0477 vol. I, 2008.01.0478 vol. II), located by matching Campbell's Greek words; Perseus does not show printed page numbers, so pages are not given. No Edmonds text was copied.

common_search_log: Internet Archive full-text search API (archive.org/services/search/beta/page_production, service_backend=fts) for English key phrases and for the Greek words of each fragment, filtered to items dated 1930 or earlier; then whole-book OCR scans for cue words.

C. Wright, Short History 1907 (shorthistoryofgr00wriguoft) and Feminism in Greek Literature 1923 (feminismingreekl00wriguoft); Mure, Critical History vols (acriticalhistor00-06muregoog); K. O. Mueller tr. Lewis 1840 and 1858 (historyofliterat00mlle, historyofliterat01mluoft); Archibald, The Fable as a Stylistic Test 1912 (fableasstylistic00archuoft); Columbia University Greek Literature lectures 1912 (cu31924022691251); Marchant, Greek Reader I 1905 (cu31924021601640); American Journal of Philology 46.2 (1925) and Classical Philology 20.2 (1925) (sim_ items); Examen miscellaneum 1702 (pseudo-Phocylides only); German: Hartung, Die griechischen Elegiker 1859 (diegriechischen02hartgoog) and Lyriker vols (diegriechischen00/01/03hartgoog, bub_gb_IdwfAAAAMAAJ), Hartung, Babrios und die aelteren Jambendichter 1858 (babriosunddielt00babrgoog: Semonides section present but OCR unusable, not checked page by page), Thudichum, Die griechischen Lyriker 1859 (diegriechischenl00thuduoft).
Oxyrhynchus Papyri X (1914, oxyrhynchuspapyr10gren): P.Oxy. 1233 fr. 3 (the Hebrus stanzas) is edited with commentary but NOT translated.

Frazer, Pausanias I (1898): the only IA copy found (in.ernet.dli.2015.282571) is mislabelled (its OCR is the index volume); HathiTrust full-view copies could not be checked by script because babel.hathitrust.org/robots.txt disallows /cgi/ for all agents (one exploratory full-text search request was made before robots.txt was read; no further HathiTrust /cgi/ requests).
Edmonds' Elegy and Iambus 1931: HathiTrust rights code 'ic' on all copies (see above).

items.search_log: P.Oxy. X (1914) prints P.Oxy. 1233 fr. 3 lines 8-15 (river flowing to the purple sea, maidens) with notes only, no translation. Edmonds, Lyra Graeca I (1922) has only a testimonium and an exempli-gratia reconstruction (prior log). IA full-text search 'Hebrus Alcaeus maidens' (to 1935) found only Edmonds/Loeb items. No pre-1930 translation in any language found. Not in Edmonds' Elegy and Iambus.
P.Oxy. 2387, first published 1957. IA full-text search 'Astymeloisa' returns only post-1957 books (Campbell, West, Ferraté, Sisti, Bonifaz Nuño ...). No public-domain translation can exist.

K. O. Mueller, History of the Literature of Ancient Greece (tr. Lewis), 1858 printing vol. I p. 186 n. 3 quotes the Greek (Bergk 'fragment 122') and renders it. Same footnote in the 1840 first edition (historyofliterat00mlle). Mure vol. III paraphrases only. Edmonds E&I fr. 137 (2027).
Brooks 1896 no. XX (Bergk 84), Greek and English on p. 11. Edmonds E&I fr. 83 (2027).
Brooks 1896 no. XXIX (Bergk 103), p. 14. Edmonds E&I fr. 106 (2027).
Brooks 1896 no. XXI (Bergk 85), p. 12. Edmonds E&I fr. 84 (2027).

No pre-1930 rendering of the verse found: Brooks 1896 does not include it; Farnell, Murray, Jevons, Jebb, Lawton, Wright, Appleton, Mure (Mure vol. III mentions Archilochus' Tantalus' rock without translating) checked by OCR scan for 'Tantal'; Hartung/Thudichum German volumes have no Archilochus Tantalus line; Frazer's Pausanias I not accessible (see common log). Edmonds E&I vol. II fr. 55 (Perseus label CURFRAG.tlg-0232.55) becomes US public domain 2027-01-01.
Brooks 1896 no. XIII (Bergk 71), p. 9. Edmonds E&I fr. 73 (2027).

E. D. Perry, 'Lyric Poetry', in Greek Literature: Lectures delivered at Columbia University (1912) p. 70: prose rendering of the Strassburg epode from 'At Salmydessus' to the end (opening words omitted). Knox 1929 does not print the Strasbourg epodes. Edmonds E&I fr. 99 (2027).

Brooks 1896 no. XXVI (Bergk 94), p. 13-14. Also rendered in Lawton 1903 and Classical Philology 20 (1925) (not ingested; Brooks preferred because it prints the Greek alongside). Edmonds E&I fr. 94 (2027).
Brooks 1896 no. XXII (Bergk 86), p. 12. Edmonds E&I fr. 85 (2027).
Brooks 1896 no. XXIII (Bergk 87), p. 12 (Brooks reads κάθημαι, Campbell κάθηται). Edmonds E&I frs. 86-87 block in Perseus (2027).
Knox 1929 frs. 57 + 59 (p. 40-43); fr. 57 is rendered only jointly with fr. 56. Partial/conflated, see record.
Knox 1929 fr. 56 (joint rendering '56 and 57', p. 41).
Knox 1929 Introduction p. 5-6 (Stobaeus lxxii. 5, 'the sense is').

items.search_log: No English found: Brooks 1896 has no Mimnermus 13; Mure vol. III only describes it; Mahaffy, Murray, Jevons, Capps, Jebb, Wright, Appleton scanned for Hermus/Hermos; IA full-text search 'Mimnermus Hermus', 'Mimnermus "Lydian horsemen"', 'ἱππομάχων' (to 1930) found only Greek editions (Bergk, Hiller, Kynaston 1890 Greek text). German: Hartung 1859 Mimnermos fr. 19 (p. 68-69) verse translation facing the Greek.

English only as an indirect paraphrase: Jevons 1886 p. 153 ('Birth is no good if a man can speak neither pleasantly nor sensibly (4)'). Full verse rendering in German: Thudichum 1859 Phokylides 4 (p. 110), ingested as a secondary record. IA full-text search of the Greek 'Φωκυλίδου γένος εὐγενὲς' found only Greek editions (Welcker, Bergk, Gaisford Stobaeus). Edmonds E&I fr. 4 (2027).

Marchant, Greek Reader I (1905) p. 3, adapted from Wilamowitz's Griechisches Lesebuch: Greek + English. Also paraphrased in Jevons 1886 p. 153 and translated in German by Thudichum 1859 (Phokylides 5) and Hartung 1859 (not ingested). Edmonds E&I fr. 5 (2027).

items.search_log: No English found (IA full-text search 'ὀξυτέρη φρήν' and English night/counsel phrasings to 1930 returned only Greek editions; Jevons, Wright, Jebb, Mure scanned). German: Thudichum 1859 Phokylides 8 (p. 110), ingested; also Hartung 1859 Phokylides 8 (IA leaf 130 of diegriechischen02hartgoog, not ingested).

No translation found. IA full-text search of the Greek 'ἐνθυμοίμεθα' (to 1930): Greek editions, the school book 'Alpha: a Greek primer' (1889; Greek text only, titled 'Brief Mourning') and Bergk/Hiller. English phrasings ('more than one day', 'more than a single day' with Simonides) found nothing; Mueller, Murray, Mahaffy, Capps, Lawton, Wright discuss Semonides fr. 7 only. German: Hartung, Babrios und die aelteren Jambendichter (1858) has a Simonides of Amorgos section but its Fraktur OCR is unusable and it was not checked page by page; Thudichum 1859 has no Semonides 2. Edmonds E&I vol. II Semonides fr. 2 (Perseus CURFRAG.tlg-0260.2) becomes US public domain 2027-01-01.
